desc: Implement feasibility check: L == 1 via min Hamming distance to the two alternating patterns; L >= 2 via summing run_len // (L + 1) over maximal runs.
Binary search minimal feasible L in [1, n] and return it from minLength.
Differential-test vs brute force on all binary strings n=1..9 and numOps 0..n; report exact mismatches and re-check the provided examples.
Confirm L == 1 uses the alternating special case (not the per-run formula) everywhere it applies, and that interior-flip placement keeps created runs <= L for L >= 2.
